spans.s:
दल् (कि) दलति दालयति 1. 10.
a. To
cut, divide; to shew; to wither.

दाल (लं) 1.
n. Wild honey.
m. Sort
of grain.
f. (ला) Colocynth.

दल-कपाट (टः) 1.
m. A folded leaf.

दल-कोष (षः) 1.
m. A sort of jasmin.

दलत्-हृदय (यः-या-यं)
a. Broken-
hearted; cut to the heart.

दलन (नः-नी-नं)
a. Breaking to
pieces. (नी)
f. A clod. (नं)
n.
Tearing or pulling to pieces.

दालन (नं) 1.
n. Tooth-ache.

दल-निर्म्मोक (कः) 1.
m. A tree whose
bark is used for
Hukah snakes.

दल-प (पः) 1.
m. Gold; sacred or
religious institute.

दल-पुष्पी (ष्पी) 3.
f. A fragrant plant
(Pandanus odoratissimus).

दल-सूचि (चिः) 2.
m. A thorn.

दल-स्नसा (सा) 1.
f. Fibre of a leaf.

दला_द्य (द्यः) 1.
m. Mud, particularly
that on the banks of a river.

दला_मल (लं) 1.
m. A tree (Vangue-
ria spinosa; Artemisia).

दला_म्ल (म्लं) 1.
n. Sorrel.

दलि (लिः-ली) 2.
n. 3.
f. A clod.

दलिक (कः) 1.
m. Timber, wood.

दलित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Blown, expand-
ed; broken torn, scattered.

दले-गन्धि (न्धिः) 2.
m. A plant or tree
(Echites scholaris).

दल्भि (ल्भिः) 2.
m. A name of
Indra;
his thunderbolt.

दालब (बः) 1.
m. A sort of poison.

दालिम (मः) 1.
m. The pomegranate.

दाल्मि (ल्मिः) 2.
m. A name of
Indra.
